correctness.rationale: The source Gibbs stationary-current parameter s maps (0,infty) bijectively to densities (0,1). Its derivative factors with exactly one positive-root quintic P(s,q) by one Descartes sign change and endpoints; the global maximizer is unique. Differentiating rho(s_*(q),q) and eliminating s gives the exact polynomial resultant 16q^6(q-1)^12(7q^4+12q^3+94q^2+20q-53), independently reconstructed symbolically. Direct evaluation at q=1 yields rho_*′(1)=1/81>0, excluding the spurious q=1 factor. The quartic increases strictly for positive q, crosses once. Weak-q analytic expansion gives derivative -1/4; large-q scaling gives positive derivative (1/3)2^(-2/3)q^(-4/3). This proves the unique reversal. Using the source eigenvalue ratio (q-1)s/((1+s)(1+qs)) on s_*=2^(1/3)q^(-1/3)+O(q^(-2/3)) yields xi_*(q)~2^(-1/3)q^(1/3). The exact original Gibbs/current input is a prior premise, not independently proved by finite experiments.
